titulo: El día que un *pastor* enfrentó a un gigante
estilo: Epic Japanese anime film still, cel shading, clean bold line art, ancient Middle East valley at golden hour, dramatic god rays, dust in the air, painterly sky, high contrast cinematic color grade, 16:9 widescreen. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

personajes.DAVID: teenage shepherd boy, slim, curly auburn hair, simple beige tunic with leather belt, leather sling in hand, calm brave eyes
personajes.GOLIAT: giant warrior three meters tall, bronze helmet and scale armor, massive spear, thick black beard, menacing
personajes.SAUL: king in his 40s, crown and red cloak over armor, worried face
personajes.SOLDADO: young Israelite soldier, leather armor, frightened

tomas.prompt: wide shot of two armies on opposite hills of a valley, a dry riverbed in the middle, golden hour
GOLIAT towering in the valley, extreme low angle, sun behind his helmet, spear raised
SOLDADO trembling behind a shield, sweat, fearful eyes, other soldiers backing away
DAVID stepping forward through the crowd of soldiers, calm face, sunlight on him
SAUL in his tent looking down at DAVID with concern, armor on a stand beside him
DAVID kneeling at a stream picking five smooth stones, water sparkling, close on his hands
extreme close-up of DAVID's eye, reflection of the giant in the iris, calm and focused
GOLIAT laughing, leaning forward, spit and dust, menacing close-up

dice.t: Vengo en el nombre del Señor.
